answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring nodes to lock capital to validate transactions. An attacker must incur the heavy cost of acquiring assets to gain influence, akin to an expensive voyage through market volatility. Unlike a fleeting whisper of unverified identities that could umber the network with fake activity, this capital commitment forces a tangible financial penalty on bad actors, ensuring that consensus remains bound to tangible economic risk rather than hollow digital personas.
